_about: Four agent variants generated from agent/agent.template.json by agent/sync_agent.py. Turn-taking can't be overridden per call in ElevenLabs, so pace needs separate agents. The backend picks the variant '{language}-{pace}' from agent/agents.lock.json. TTS model is pinned per language: ElevenLabs requires English agents to use an English-only turbo/flash v2 model (API error 'English Agents must use turbo or flash v2', Oct 10 2026); Spanish needs the multilingual eleven_flash_v2_5. LLM pinned (WS1 V9, Oct 11 2026) to the evaluated model, eval/results/latest.json model.agent; backup_llm_order_claude is used because it is a Claude model, so fallbacks stay in the evaluated family. ELEVENLABS_LLM overrides it for experiments only: a model that was not evaluated needs an llm_note in agent/deployed_snapshot.json (sync_agent.py --snapshot --llm-note) and a re-evaluation. agent/check_config_hash.py compares the deployed config with this file.
